title: Hydrogen placement
hints: The name identifies the H–C≡N connectivity.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: H has a duet with one bond. C can be central and supports the C≡N triple bond.
statement:
Which connectivity is appropriate for hydrogen cyanide?

[_]{a}

explanations: This is the connectivity of HCN.
Hydrogen cannot form two ordinary two-electron bonds here.
This is the distinct hydrogen isocyanide connectivity.
